content.text: The text surveys diseases of the intestine, rectum, and anus, including cancer, lardaceous degeneration, prolapse, polyps, hemorrhoids, strictures, proctitis, fissures, ulcers, abscesses, fistulae, syphilis, tuberculosis, and neurologic disorders. It describes symptoms, pathology, prognosis, diagnosis, and historical treatments, emphasizing palliative care for advanced malignancy and surgery for selected obstruction or fistula cases. It then reviews intestinal parasites—tapeworms, flukes, nematodes, trichinae, and filariae—their life cycles, transmission through contaminated food, water, animals, or undercooked meat, clinical effects, treatments, and prevention. Finally, it introduces functional liver disorders including biliousness, lithaemia, and hepatic glycosuria.
